servinfo.title: Speed limiter system cannot resume maximum speed stored in memory after the system was canceled by CANCEL switch

item.ptxt: Perform speed limiter system check referring to Speed Limiter System Check:Adaptive Cruise Control before performing this Speed Limiter System Symptom Diagnosis.
Check each part in the order from the top of the following list.

condition.ptxt: Speed limiter system cannot resume maximum speed stored in memory after the system was canceled by CANCEL switch
